title: Marimba: A System One Model for Speech
abstract: arXiv:2611.18330v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Speech applications require decisions about term presence, turn completion, and language within an audio window. We present Marimba, an interface for typed speech decisions built on frozen Qwen3-ASR 0.6B features. Lexical questions use zero-shot scoring of ASR transcripts; non-lexical questions use a question-conditioned head and a separate layer-18 turn-end readout. Language identification uses the ASR model's own language scores. On private conversational test sets, decoder AUROC is 0.80-0.92; on public read speech it is 0.92-0.97. Speech Commands four-way accuracy is 0.93; binary lexical ECE is at most 0.08. Personal-information detection, which passes the greedy transcript to a private, curated PII pipeline, reaches item-level F1 0.904 on synthetic Brazilian Portuguese speech (1.000 on reference transcripts). translated_title: Marimba：一个面向语音的“系统一”模型

tldr: Marimba基于冻结的Qwen3-ASR 0.6B特征构建了一个轻量级“系统一”语音决策接口，通过零样本评分、条件化读出头和中间层探针，在词项检测、轮次结束判断、语言识别、个人信息检测和说话人变化检测等多项语音决策任务上取得了优异且良好校准的性能。
en_tdlr: Marimba is a lightweight "System 1" interface for typed speech decisions built on frozen Qwen3-ASR 0.6B features, achieving strong and well-calibrated performance on term presence, turn completion, language identification, PII detection, and speaker-change detection via zero-shot scoring, conditioned readout heads, and mid-layer probes.
